snippet.title: Galactic Glitch - Official 1.0 Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Galactic Glitch 1.0 available on June 3 on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1536620/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer&utm_campaign=galactic_glitch_full_release

Galactic Glitch is an Action-Roguelike with physics-based combat mechanics. Blast your way through the Corrupted, hurl massive rocks, catch missiles, bounce foes off walls and rip your enemies to shreds in challenging space combat. Get it on Steam today!

Get Updates on Discord: https://discord.gg/6jPYbpZa2g
